ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_RELATEDCUSTOMER_CCD
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer
AS(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,RelatedCustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT 
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS RelatedCustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM    
	,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION 

    SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS RelatedCustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM    
	,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
 LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.RelatedCustomer WHERE SOURCECODE = 'CCD'	AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.RelatedCustomerId,TGT.RelatedCustomerId) AS RelatedCustomerId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA;

-----UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.RelatedCustomer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;
 
------INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.RelatedCustomer ( 
CustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerRelationshipTypeId
,RelatedCustomerNote
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId AS RelatedCustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerRelationshipTypeId
,NULL AS RelatedCustomerNote
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.RelatedCustomer ( 
CustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerRelationshipTypeId
,RelatedCustomerNote
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId AS RelatedCustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerRelationshipTypeId
,NULL AS RelatedCustomerNote
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA;

END
